# Rumie Learn

> > Free microlearning platform offering bite-sized lessons (Bytes) on career skills, digital literacy, personal finance, mental health, and online privacy.

Rumie Learn provides practical, accessible educational content designed for quick learning. The platform covers essential life skills from job interview techniques and goal-setting to privacy protection across browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and privacy-focused alternatives like DuckDuckGo, Brave, and Tor Browser.

## Key Topics

- Career skills and job hunting
- Interview follow-up and thank-you letters
- Mental health and mindfulness
- Online privacy and ad tracking prevention
- Browser privacy (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Privacy-focused browsers (DuckDuckGo, Brave, Tor Browser, Ghostery)
- Digital citizenship
- Personal finance and expense tracking
- Bullying and cyberbullying prevention
- Cookie management
- Google ad settings
- Stretch goals and personal growth
- Shopping privacy protection

## Career Development & Professional Skills

- [Send the Perfect Interview Follow-Up](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/send-the-perfect-interview-follow-up): Guide on following up after job interviews with thank-you letters
- [Reach Your Potential With 'Stretch' Goals](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/reach-your-potential-with-stretch-goals): Tutorial on setting stretch goals for personal growth, inspired by Google X

## Digital Privacy & Online Safety

- [4 ways you can prevent websites from tracking your shopping RIGHT NOW ⛔](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/4-ways-you-can-prevent-websites-from-tracking-your-shopping-right-now): Tutorial on preventing online shopping tracking via Google, Facebook & Chrome
- [Breaking Down Bullying](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/breaking-down-bullying): Guide to identifying types of bullying including cyberbullying & harassment

## Personal Finance & Money Management

- [Learn to track your expenses in 6 minutes 📈](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/learn-to-track-your-expenses-in-6-minutes): Quick tutorial on expense tracking using Mint, PocketGuard & Excel

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Practicing Mindfulness](https://learn.rumie.org/jR/bytes/practicing-mindfulness): Guide to mindfulness meditation and breathing exercises for stress relief
